statement: RESULT-side status of the plan's six official-driver rows. The plan itself is the immutable denominator and is NOT edited: its driver_rows keep their NOT_IMPLEMENTED seed, because the plan body feeds plan_root and archived verdicts pin that root. A row here is EXECUTED only because tools/evidence/verify_drivers.py re-derived its leaf outcomes from the archived bytes and returned zero anomalies; every other row names the exact external precondition that blocks it.

TypeDB CE - the only server this repository builds - is single-node, so no cluster can be stood up here. Executed and observed: the binary prints 'Skipping Cluster tests in a non-clustered environment' and runs zero scenarios.

caveats.detail: http-ts declares packageManager 'pnpm@8.15.9' and ships pnpm-lock.yaml (sha256 5617f6a91f82ae909edfba27c88001612149a63323eac4e9f52af9b41fbedf92), but the pnpm available here is 10.x, which does not honour a v8 lockfile without migrating it. Dependencies were therefore resolved by npm within package.json's ranges. Every exact pin was verified to have installed at its pinned version, and the full resolved tree is archived as npm-tree.json, but the transitive closure is NOT the closure the committed pnpm lockfile names.
